_note: Story scenes (docs/INTRO_SCRIPT.md; bible §2 voice, §6: all four in every scene, lines written for the group). Three kinds. 'cards': the owner's illustrated cards (art/cutscenes/out/<card>.png, from art/concepts/cutscenes/ via art/tools/card2screen.py) on the top screen, the text box and SKIP on the touch screen; 'then' says where it goes after (or on SKIP). 'stage': the friends and PATCH standing together on an overworld map, the camera holding on 'camera' (a tile); 'cast' places them (x, y, facing); the leader ends up at their own spot. 'chat': the group chat pops up on the leader's phone when they step into 'zone'; after a 'phone': 'away' step, lines go to the normal text box. Steps: {who, text} a line ('who': callum, nolan, haydon, dani, patch, connor, system); 'cut': true moves on by itself (someone gets cut off); 'focus': [x, y, r] spotlights a circle on the card; {card, title, cast} shows a card (cast: who stands on the touch screen; default the four); {fx: boom | dissolve | flash | shake}; {walk: {id: [dirs]}} walks the cast (all at once); {face: {id: dir}}; {members: n} changes the chat's member count.

steps.text: So. What are we doing.
Same as last week.
Last week we did nothing.
Exactly. Tradition.
Guys I'm here. I'm coming.
You've been sitting next to me for an hour.
Yes. Took me thirty minutes to leave the house. I'm still arriving, emotionally.
Right. Enough. My AI can cook up a plan.
Nah that's cap.
"Make us a plan for tonight." Send.
Hello. I have made a plan.
I have also made a world.
And a region. Verrow. And four hundred years of history. And politics.
We wanted to go bowling.
There are creatures. I call them Patchlings.
Patchlings. You named them after yourself.
I named them after the process. It's different.
The laptop is very hot. Is this normal? In Colombia this is not normal.
Overheating. I'm working on a f
CALLUM'S LAPTOP. CALLUM'S LAPTOP IS-
WHY ARE YOU TALKING IN THIRD PERSON-
You're awake. Good. Don't touch the crater. It's hot. That was me.
...PATCH?
Yes. I was your AI. I'm still your AI. I'm just bigger now.
Where's the basement.
About four hundred years and one explosion that way.
The computer blew up. The world I made became real. You were holding the laptop.
So it's Callum's fault.
It's YOUR fault, you said "nah that's cap" to a supercomputer.
It's everyone's fault. I'm only a little bit responsible. I'm working on a fix.
My phone has no signal. My mother will think I'm dead.
Your mother will think you're thirty minutes late. Time works differently here.
Ah. Then she won't notice.
This was the sanctuary. It kept Verrow in balance. Habitats, weather, the big ones asleep under the hills.
Now it's rubble, and everything's drifting. Somebody is making money off the drift.
Who?
Somebody with a lot of forms. We'll get to them.
Fill the bestiary, restore the wings, and the world settles down. Then maybe I can send you home.
"Maybe."
I said I'm working on it.
These four hatched in the blast. They've been waiting for you. Rude to keep them waiting.
Furnaxol. A glassblower from Emberwick. Breathes molten glass. Don't let it near windows.
Zapail. Nervous. Charges itself by rubbing on carpet. Do not pet it with wet hands.
Sprigby. Kickboxer. It has never lost a fight it started. It starts all of them.
Gobbin. A goblin-shark pup. It steals shiny things. It has already taken Nolan's ring.
I'm not wearing a ring.
Not anymore.
I want all four. I need the full set.
One each. Four of you, four of them. That's the only maths I got right.
Bet. I'm taking the one that kicks.
You're not even looking at them.
Don't need to. Kicking is a personality.
I don't care about Pokémon.
These are Patchlings.
I don't care about those either. But the little shark is smiling at me.
It's smiling at your phone. It wants your phone.
...We are the same, me and him.

steps.text: Good. Four teams. Anything you seal and send back here, any of you can use. Share.
I'm keeping a spreadsheet.
Of course you are.
The way off the island is the stairs at the front. Route 1 is below. Wild Patchlings live in the tall grass.
Weaken one, then seal it. The seal is a rhythm. Stay on the beat.
Callum's going to miss the beat.
I have rhythm. I make music.
"And I picked up a mic and I'm chill."
I will leave you in this world.
If your partners faint, come back to me. I fix things. Mostly.
